gallery-list.response: Server-rendered HTML; rows are <tr class="ub-content ..."> inside .gall_list
gallery-list.notes: Minor galleries on the general path answer 200 with a tiny <script>location.replace(...)</script> that drops the query string; mini galleries answer 404 on the general path. Search scans only the newest block of posts (search_pos pages further back; not used).

gallery-post.response: Server-rendered HTML: .gallview_head, .write_div, hidden inputs e_s_n_o and _GALLTYPE_ (G | M | MI). Comments are NOT in this HTML.

post-comments.response: JSON {total_cnt, comments:[{no, name, memo(html), reg_date, depth, c_no, nicktype, del_yn}], pagination}
post-comments.notes: Same endpoint for all gallery types. Without e_s_n_o the body is '정상적인 접근이 아닙니다.'. The token is not post-bound. ~100 comments per page. Rows with nicktype COMMENT_BOY / no 0 are ads; del_yn Y are deleted.

general-gallery-post-write.notes: UI strategy with SmartEditor iframe/textarea injection, alert suppression, and CAPTCHA handling.
